name: Web Developer

sections.daily_work: Build and maintain websites and web apps. Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Collaborate with designers and back-end developers. Debug cross-browser issues.
sections.learning: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, front-end frameworks (React, Vue), basic back-end (Node.js), version control (Git), accessibility standards.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $45,000-$70,000 USD. Mid-level $70,000-$110,000. Senior roles can exceed $130,000. Verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Self-learning via freeCodeCamp or The Odin Project, web development bootcamps, computer science degree, portfolio of personal projects, freelance gigs to build experience.

try_in_real_life: Complete a free HTML/CSS course (try freeCodeCamp)
Build a personal website or blog from scratch
Inspect the source code of websites you admire (right-click > Inspect)
Research junior web developer job postings in your area
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh); web developer industry surveys
